LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.mul_entropy_le_mu: Consider an iid source with law p on a finite alphabet S and a finite memoryless channel W with a nonempty input alphabet. For any encoder and decoder using n channel uses for n source symbols, with block error probability e, nH(p) ≤ nC(W) + ln 2 + e · n · ln |S|.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.entropy_le_channe: For an iid finite-alphabet source and a finite memoryless channel with nonempty input alphabet, suppose a sequence of encoders and decoders uses the channel once per symbol and its block error tends to zero. Then H(p) ≤ C(W).
